applicabilityBasis.summary: XSGD is represented as a payment and settlement token maintaining a 1:1 SGD value. The July 2026 token and redemption terms identify its legal issuer and provide conditional fiat SGD redemption for holders, subject to onboarding, restrictions, fees, and processing requirements. These features support apparent-payment-stablecoin applicability under GENIUS Act section 2(22); they do not establish U.S. authorization.

genius.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-07. Current token terms name StraitsX SGD Issuance Pte. Ltd. as XSGD issuer and distinguish StraitsX Payment Services Pte Ltd as distributor. Holders have conditional 1:1 fiat SGD redemption. The opened KK Yap & Associates report provides reasonable assurance over reserves and circulation at 31 August 2026 and is dated 28 September 2026. MAS licensing and issuer-reported Singapore SCS substantive-compliance acknowledgement do not establish GENIUS approval, Treasury comparability, or OCC foreign registration. No such token-specific authorization or announced U.S. application was found within the reviewed evidence; issuer pathway and foreign-exception status remain unknown. Treasury's 17 August 2026 proposal identifies 18 January 2027 as the expected Act effective date and 18 July 2028 for the broader DASP licensed-issuer offer/sale restriction. The 30 September 2026 SCRC interim rule establishes procedural forms and does not authorize an issuer or certify a state regime; certifications await Paperwork Reduction Act approval. These general materials support pre-effective not-yet-restricted posture, subject to final-rule developments. Corrected obsolete issuerEntity StraitsX / Xfers Pte. Ltd. to StraitsX SGD Issuance Pte. Ltd. on explicit token terms; the StraitsX issuer-key prefix remains unchanged. Global Coinbase distribution is not evidence of U.S. or EEA eligibility. The legacy Coinbase buy URL now redirects to a generic market page and is omitted.
